content:
Apple's much-anticipated smart home hub (which we've been calling the HomePad) will be unveiled on October 13, according to Bloomberg.

The device is reportedly equipped with a 6-inch display, with design inspiration drawn from the iMac G4, and will launch alongside an updated HomePod mini (with new colors) and a new generation of Apple TV 4K with Siri AI support...

The same source previously only said the device was expected to launch "as early as October," but the latest report clearly specifies October 13.

The iMac G4 is one of Apple's most iconic designs, featuring a hemispherical base with a screen that appears to float, able to swivel, raise, lower, and tilt to any position you desire. I said a year ago that I really hope Apple will bring this beautiful design back for this new product.

Previous reports have also mentioned that the device will come in two versions: the desktop version mentioned here, and another designed to be wall-mounted.

Top Rated Comment by RedMustache

This thing will be a tough decision for me...

I've been waiting for this product for a long time, but during this time, I've already gotten used to using the HomePod and the Home app to control devices at home. To make me willing to open my wallet, it really needs some standout features. I wonder if they'll surprise us by releasing the rumored robotic arm version?

This upcoming device is expected to have a built-in speaker, able to function as a HomePod while also serving as a smart home control panel. It reportedly runs a new operating system that combines elements of iOS, tvOS, and watchOS, with Siri AI at its core.

Daring Fireball also pointed out that iPhone Duo review units will be delivered to tech reviewers on October 13 or 14, and mentioned that since Apple likes to hold hands-on events for important products in person, combining the two into a single launch event would make a lot of sense.

Today's report says the internal codename for this device is J490. Are you planning to buy one? Feel free to share your thoughts in the comments.
